To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

nicotinic acid is an effective treatment for hyperlipidemia, but is also associated with side effects, such as flushing, and is less effective than other niacin formulations for treating dyslipidemia.

(i) nicotinic acid is a vitamin, and its metabolite nicotinamide is a vitamin, (ii) nicotinic acids are precursors to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), (iii) NMN is a precursor to NAD+, and (iv) NAD+ is an essential cofactor in all cells.
(1) NAD+ is a central regulator of metabolism, aging and disease and (2) NAD+ synthesis can be enhanced by nicotinamide and nicotinamideriboside, but not by nicotinic acid.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel therapies to treat neurological disorders and infectious disease by increasing NAD+ levels in the human brain and other organs.
the development of novel therapies for the treatment of neurological disorders.
the development of novel, safe, and effective therapeutic approaches to the treatment of human diseases.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
nicotinamid riboside is a safe and effective precursor of neuronal NAD+ and that it should be considered as a supplement in the treatment of neurological diseases and disorders.
the current state of knowledge supports the recommendation that the daily niacin requirement be met with a combination of nicotinamide and nicotinic acid.
the current evidence supports the conclusion that nicotinamides are essential vitamins and that nicotinamine riboside is an essential vitamin precursor.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the NAD+ precursor nicotinamide may be the most effective vitamin to prevent and/or treat neurological degeneration and Candida glabratta infection, whereas nicotinic acid or nicotinamide might be most beneficial for enhancing reverse cholesterol transport.

NAD+ synthesis is an active and dynamic process that requires a balance of tryptophol, tryptamine, nicotinuric acid, nicotinic acids, and nicotinic acid amides to support the NAD+ requirements of specific tissues and to maintain NAD+-dependent processes.
NAD+ synthesis is a complex process, which can be modulated with a variety of dietary precursors, and which has a significant impact on health and disease.
The main takeaway from our work is that
nicotinamic riboside is the most effective NAD+ precursor in humans.
nicotinamides are more than just precursors for the coenzymes NAD+ and NADP+; they are also signaling molecules that can regulate gene transcription.
the NAD+ biosynthetic pathways and the NAD+-dependent signaling pathways are highly compartmentalized, with distinct requirements for each of the NAD+ precursor vitamin cofactors.
